CHN.hook: Borders fourteen countries, tied with Russia for the most on Earth — yet the whole country runs on a single time zone.
CHN.place: The eastern bulk of Asia, from the Pacific coast west to the Himalaya and the Central Asian deserts.
CHN.borders: The Qing empire's outer reach, largely kept — which is why Tibet and Xinjiang are inside; the Himalayan line with India was never fully agreed (Aksai Chin and Arunachal Pradesh are both still contested), while the river borders with Russia, drawn in the 1860s, were finally settled in 2008.

MNG.hook: The least densely populated sovereign country on Earth — about two people per square kilometre, and more horses than people.
MNG.place: Landlocked between Russia and China, with nothing else touching it.
MNG.borders: Outer Mongolia's Qing-era administrative limits, frozen when it broke away in 1911–24 under Russian protection; Inner Mongolia stayed Chinese, and the border is mostly survey lines across steppe and the Gobi rather than any river or crest.
